wiki.title: Frank Ciccone
wiki.extract: Frank A. Ciccone III (born October 10, 1947, in Providence, Rhode Island) is an American politician and a Democratic member of the Rhode Island Senate representing District 7 since January 2005. Ciccone served consecutively from January 2003 until January 2005 in the District 3 seat. He was elected as majority leader in April 2025.
